name: Newsletter Subscriber Enrollment
description: Create or reactivate an Airtable newsletter subscription by email, then send a plain-text Gmail confirmation.
requirements: Airtable connection with Provider API permission and data.records:read/write access to the subscribers base
Subscribers table with Email, Topic, Status, Interval and Start Day fields and Email upsert support
Gmail connection with permission to send confirmation emails
